requirement.value: Cunning Folk, Spiritist or Elementalist mastery

system.description: CAPPED — choose ONE category when you take it; the choice is permanent. Printed, all your spells gain an extra effect forever across six categories: multi-target spells cost 10 MP less · damaging spells +10 damage (+15 at 20, +20 at 40) · healing +10 HP (+15 at 20, +20 at 40) · negative-status spells also apply enraged or poisoned · positive-status spells also apply one of dex-up, mig-up, wlp-up or ins-up · resource-draining spells double what they gain. The source's own limiter: a spell qualifying for two categories uses one, chosen per casting. Uncapped this is the largest heroic in the collection — always on, every spell, for the rest of the campaign — so mastery-gating alone is not enough. Note it does not require Cunning Folk: a mastered Spiritist or Elementalist can hold it having never touched the class.
